description: List the public curated lists in the notavibe catalog, or return the public members of one list identified by owner handle and list slug. Only public lists and their publishable members are returned; a list that does not exist or is not public returns {"found": false, "subject": "list"}. handle and slug are given together or not at all; one without the other is refused as an invalid argument. Read-only. Serves catalog schema v1.

handle.description: List owner handle; together with slug, it selects one list.

slug.description: List slug; together with handle, it selects one list.

name: get_lists
